packageRules.description: Was the npm ecosystem in .github/dependabot.yml: weekly, no grouping and no limit. Dev-tooling bumps are grouped here, which is why eight PRs were open at once before this.

typescript 5 -> 7 and vite 7 -> 8 were open as Dependabot #30 and #41 and are deliberately not folded into the migration PR: both are majors on the build toolchain and neither is verified. Renovate will re-raise them as separate PRs rather than inside the dev-dependencies group.
